name: Shimea
title: David's brother
summary: Shimea (also known as Shammah or Shimei) was one of Jesse's sons and thus a brother of King David. He is best known as the father of Jonathan, who killed a Philistine giant, and as part of David's close family circle. In David's lineage, Shimea played a role as a member of the royal family in the united kingdom.

keyEvents.title: Jesse's Sons Presented to Samuel
keyEvents.description: When the prophet Samuel came to Bethlehem to anoint a new king, Jesse's sons, including Shimea (Shammah), were presented to him, but none of them were chosen until David arrived.

keyEvents.title: Shimea Among His Brothers in Saul's Army
keyEvents.description: Shimea was among David's older brothers who served in Saul's army when the Philistines threatened Israel, during the period when Goliath challenged the Israelites.

keyEvents.title: Shimea's Son Jonathan Kills a Giant
keyEvents.description: Shimea's son Jonathan (also called Jonathan ben Shimea) killed a Philistine giant who had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot.

keyEvents.title: Jonadab, Shimea's Son, Gives Advice to Amnon
keyEvents.description: Shimea's son Jonadab was known as a wise but cunning man who gave advice to David's son Amnon that led to the tragic incident involving Tamar.

keyEvents.title: Shimea Mentioned in David's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Shimea is listed among Jesse's sons in the genealogies of Chronicles, where he is called Shimea and counted as the third son.
